megatron.forward_callsite: LanguageModule.compute_language_model_loss dispatches by cross_entropy_loss_fusion and cross_entropy_fusion_impl to TE, native fused, or tensor_parallel.vocab_parallel_cross_entropy
megatron.backward_relevance: Backward mutates saved softmax-derived state into rank-local logits gradients.
megatron.graph_pattern: unfused: local max -> TP MAX -> target ownership -> TP SUM(predicted) -> exp/sum -> TP SUM(sum-exp) -> loss; native fused: MAX then one packed SUM for predicted plus sum-exp

tensor_contract.training_inference_distinction: Training-only loss path; label smoothing and saved backward operands are contractual.

distributed_context.tensor_parallel: required contiguous vocabulary partition; unfused trace is MAX,SUM,SUM while native fused trace is MAX,SUM with predicted and sum-exp packed together
distributed_context.sequence_parallel: N may be sequence-partitioned by caller

replacement_boundary.replace: one declared dispatch variant: its full custom autograd function and exact config-specific collective trace
replacement_boundary.fallback_detection: assert the selected variant and custom path marker on every TP rank

distributed_checks: collective sequence identical on all ranks
